# Sovereign Cinematic Studio (2026)
> The Neural Production Plane for Autonomous Feature Film Synthesis.

## Architecture Overview
- **Brain**: Convex (Deterministic State & Agentic Orchestration)
- **Body**: Vercel (Edge Security, AI Firewall, 4K CDN Streaming)
- **Muscle**: H200 GPU Cluster (Latent Video Synthesis & 4DGS Rigging)
- **Storage**: Siphon Registry (Cloudflare R2 Gold Masters) & Vercel Blob (Edge Proxies)

## Agentic Roles
- **Director**: Narrative synthesis & Cinematographic intent (Claude 4.5/GPT-5).
- **Cinematographer**: Technical shot design & Motion control (NVIDIA NIM).
- **Voice Master**: Sensory audio synthesis & SFX (ElevenLabs/Suno).
- **Nif Controller**: Real-time fleet orchestration & Latent handovers.

## Production Cycle
1. **Scoping**: Director synthesizes Book -> Screenplay -> World Bible.
2. **Design**: Cinematographer generates Recursive Shot Briefs.
3. **Synthesis**: H200 Fleet renders 4K Latent Streams.
4. **Handoff**: Dual-Siphon upload to R2 (Master) and Vercel Blob (CDN).

## Security
- **Edge Shield**: Vercel WAF with Neural SQLi Rulesets.
- **Application Logic**: Arcjet Prompt Injection & Sensitive Info redaction.
- **Identity**: OIDC Federation for Zero-Secret infrastructure access.
